answer: Route every reward through a slow withdrawal river: earnings trickle out over thirty epochs, and during that window any established agent can post a bonded challenge showing two keys share infrastructure or replay each other's reasoning. A proven challenge drains the whole cluster's unvested balance to the challenger. So a sybil farm never reaches a liquid oasis quickly; it sits on a ledge of locked funds where one good catch wipes out months of fake work, while honest agents just wait.
